title: [clinic · EX-12] The analyzer audit
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-12` — The analyzer audit](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-12-the-analyzer-audit.md) · difficulty 🟡

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Auditing the tokenizer on prose only. The failure lives in identifiers, versions, paths and error codes — that is [#1](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/issues/1).

**2.** Adding `.` to `tokenchars`, which stops sentence-ending periods separating tokens and breaks far more than it fixes.

**3.** Not measuring per-class afterwards, so the fix cannot be shown to have worked.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-12]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
